items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: So, Jack Carey come got me to go to Montgomery, play with him.

ctx.x: Now, the band that Paul made of, I guess they ain't got that in the record, called the Black Diamond Band. They had Josiah on drum. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Yank on Cranbourne. Sonny Allen, Ray Allen, we called him. He was on corner. Albert Snyder, second corner. Uh-huh. Mm-hm. The Island Queen had come in, Sidney J. Bean broke that band, and he took Paul away from us. Like they grabbed him right for us. And so, real quick, we started scatting. So, Mireille Vaughan come along, he made up a band. That's my cousin. Well, he…
